briefdescription.para: Test if the specified child is used as an R-Value, which is something that yields a value.

detaileddescription.para: In most cases, an expression is used as an R-Value (i.e. it has a value), but an expression can be used as a left side of an assignment, for example, which makes it an L-Value. In a few cases, an expression can be used as both an R-Value and an L-Value, such as with the pre-/post-increment/-decrement operators.
